hero.title: Learn Tarot
hero.lead: Tarot, one card at a time.
body: Short, cinematic video courses designed to make tarot easy to understand, enjoyable to learn, and easier to remember.
Through film, imagery, narration and sound, each course brings a single card to life - its story, symbolism, history and meaning within a reading.
hero.note: Be the first to know when the courses are released.
hero.imageAlt: A laptop on a candlelit desk, playing a film of a cloaked figure and a dog on a moonlit ridge.

stepInside.heading: Discover. Explore. Understand.
body: Each course takes you inside the card, revealing its story, symbols, and deeper meaning. Learn how it is evolved through history and how its meaning can change within a reading.
The lessons are divided into short, easy-to-follow chapters, so you can learn at your own pace and build your understanding naturally, one card a time.

sun.alt: The Sun: a golden sun with a human face, blazing above clouds.

chariot.alt: The Chariot: a charioteer driving two white horses across open ground.

star.alt: The Star: a woman pouring water into a pool beneath a bright star.

seventyEight.heading: 78 CARDS. ONE STORY AT A TIME.
seventyEight.intro: Whether you're discovering tarot for the first time or deepening what you already know, these courses are designed to make the cards clearer, more memorable and more intuitive to read.

film.title: CINEMATIC VIDEOS
film.body: Beautifully illustrated lessons that bring each card to life.

book.title: EASY TO FOLLOW
book.body: Short, focused chapters you can enjoy at your own pace.

cards.title: BUILD REAL SKILLS
cards.body: Gain confidence and intuition in your own readings.

tarotMap.heading: A MAP OF THE TAROT
tarotMap.intro: As you explore the cards, you'll begin to see how they connect — and how the deck works as a whole.

major.title: MAJOR ARCANA
major.body: The larger forces, archetypes, and turning points that shape the human journey.

court.title: COURT CARDS
court.body: Figures that can represent people, roles, personalities, or ways of being.

minor.title: MINOR ARCANA
minor.body: The experiences, choices, challenges, and circumstances of everyday life.
